findings.title: Structurally issued witness can be promoted into actual service
findings.analysis: Producer brand is checked, but registry authority is structural issuedRoot/record callbacks. A lookalike registry returning actualRoot and accepting record can run the real fixed producer with real ref/generation strings and receive a module-branded witness; actual service.record(returnedWitness) then checks only that global brand and matching ref/generation/root, and supplies its own private ledger token. It cannot prove issuance used this service. The raw-ledger token fix therefore does not prevent actual-service promotion, contrary to014 service-issued capability requirement. B0-6 only observes service lookup before attempting promotion. Its first new NativeCacheWitnessLedger(()=>root) argument becomes token, with no roots resolver, so wrapper refuses ROOT_FOREIGN while the test expects WITNESS_REFUSED; that failure prevents reaching the lookalike branch. No browser exploit was executed.
findings.minimum_same_scope_action: Bind issuance and actual insertion to one existing service-issued opaque capability for service/ref/root/generation, refusing structural registries before production. Test actual service.record plus reader consumption of a lookalike-issued witness; separate scenarios to prevent early refusal from hiding the insertion boundary. No public DTO/persistent authority needed.

Every successful acquisition leaves narralens-n1n2-film-* and film.html under tmpdir, outside fixture roots and lease/reader cleanup. findings.minimum_same_scope_action: Release the owned private copy after both parse success and failure; preserve primary plus all cleanup errors, and report genuine uncertainty. Add bounded copy-lifetime success/failure assertions while retaining legacy and pinned parser behavior.

findings.title: Preexisting poster preservation and exact picture pairing are incomplete
findings.analysis: The preexisting check inspects only the target pageframe JPEG, not a preexisting poster or partial JSON/stamp. B0-3 writes only old film-poster.jpg and expects PREEXISTING with byte preservation, but no target JPEG means265 cannot refuse it. For film.html/ms<0/width480 the pinned producer overwrites that old poster. For kind film-poster with another rel/ms/width the wrapper merely retains an existing poster; it neither validates this is the native poster-writing request nor compares poster bytes to returned JPEG. Thus an unrelated old poster can be paired with a different real pageframe draw. Last-poster semantics are permitted, but014 still requires exact witnessed pairing. This is static, not a claimed browser test outcome.
findings.minimum_same_scope_action: Validate the exact native poster-writing request and returned-JPEG/poster pairing. Under the selected refusal/preservation policy, reject relevant unwitnessed preexisting members/poster before side effects. Add separate old-poster/partial-triple/wrong-request negatives without broad cache clearing or fake media facts.

findings.title: Cache dependency identities lack final held fence and consumption check
findings.analysis: PRE/POST snapshots now compare ctime/dev/ino/hash/bytes, which is a real improvement. Yet held PRE dependency descriptors and POST resources are not revalidated after asynchronous stamp/picture reads before issue/record. A dependency/root/parent can move after its sampled facts and before issuance. Reader accepts witness dependencies using only sha256/bytes, ignoring stored dev/ino/mtime/ctime; a new stable source round can accept an old producer witness after same-byte inode replacement. Independent fresh source proof does not refresh the old producer witness. Output witness stores digests but no triple identities, although014 requires content and identity matching. Browser bodies assert happy-path dependency membership/digest, not these mutation/restore barriers.
findings.minimum_same_scope_action: After all producer/read callbacks, synchronously fence held dependency identities/content without rejecting legitimate cache creation as whole-tree drift; check witnessed identities at reader consumption or explicitly re-witness under014. Add proposed dependency same-inode change/restorebytes+mtime, samebytes-newinode and triple/parent swap negatives.

findings.title: Witness is inserted before cleanup certainty and finally can replace primary
findings.analysis: Wrapper inserts witness in actual registry at342 before after.release and before.release. A release failure rejects the call but leaves the issued witness usable; its uncertainty is not adopted by reader. Nested finally attempts both releases, but a cleanup throw can replace the original dependency/producer error and the outer release can replace the inner release error. This repeats the original primary+all-cleanup/sticky requirement in the newly added cache owner. Fixture withCleanup cannot repair overwritten internal primary or revoke a published witness.

Preserve primary and all release causes and genuine uncertainty, with no numericFD retry. Add the original before/after publication cleanup failure cases within the existing private module.
